TOPIC: Urgent[LUXSHARE TECHNOLOGIES (VIETNAM) CO., LTD]_The Module NXTR Right continuously reported error codes 80001203 and 1204. Initial inspection indicated that the vacuum pressure did not meet the required specification, preventing the ma...
Communication Content:
Dear Call Center,
Recently, our customer has encountered an issue with the vacuum pump of the NXTR machine.

- Symptom

Module 1 Right on Line V1-02 repeatedly generated error codes 80001203 and 80001204. Initial inspection found that the vacuum pressure was insufficient, preventing the machine from operating normally.

- Inspection and Troubleshooting Process

The vacuum pressure was checked first and confirmed to be below the required level. The head was then inspected, and all nozzles/covers were properly sealed, eliminating the possibility of vacuum leakage from the head.

Next, the vacuum pump was activated through the I/O screen; however, the right-side vacuum pump did not operate. The machine was restarted, but the same errors remained.

The module was pulled out for further inspection, confirming that the right-side vacuum pump was not running. The pump filter was cleaned, but the issue persisted, ruling out a clogged filter as the cause.

To maintain production, the module was temporarily set to "Skip Module", allowing the production line to continue running.

After production stopped, the inverter boards on the left and right sides were swapped for verification. The fault remained on the right side, indicating that the inverter board was not the root cause.

The left and right vacuum pumps were then swapped. At the same time, all pneumatic tubes were reconnected, and all fuses and connectors on the interface board were reinstalled. After completing these actions, the vacuum pump returned to normal operation.

The machine was then run in "Idle" mode for observation. It operated normally, and no further errors were detected.

- Additional Verification

On the following day, the "Do Part Height Check" and "Do Place Check" functions were enabled in the production program, and the machine operated normally.

A different program with these two functions disabled was then tested, and the same error reoccurred.

Finally, "Do Part Height Check" and "Do Place Check" were enabled again for production. During subsequent monitoring, the machine operated stably, and no recurrence of the error was observed.

- Could you please clarify:

Do these functions change the vacuum control sequence or the timing of vacuum pressure monitoring?
Do they introduce additional delays that allow the vacuum pressure to stabilize before the system performs the vacuum check?
Is there any known relationship between these two functions and the vacuum pump control logic or the generation of error codes 80001203 and 80001204?

- We would appreciate your explanation of the underlying control logic and any recommendations for further troubleshooting.

Detail error:
- Module type: 2RV 
- Module SN: 1-L 0000731
- Base SN: 0202163
- Version: (V2.2Bm)
- The trace was collected from 5:15 pm to 5:30pm Aug 3,2026

There are two temporary workarounds._x000D_
_x000D_

please resend that JOB to the entire line once._x000D_
_x000D_
This issue occurs when you perform an on-machine edit from AIMEXR or AIMEXIIIc, apply the changes to Nexim, and then perform the same operation in XPF._x000D_
This specific sequence of steps is the condition under which the issue occurs._x000D_

in the “AIMEXR Advanced Operation Manual.”_x000D_
The content is the same in AIMEXIII as well._x000D_
However, “Override” can only be used for editable items._x000D_
For example, you cannot use “Override” to set placement coordinates._x000D_
ーー_x000D_

Communication Content:
Dear FMV-The-san,_x000D_
_x000D_
Thank you for the update._x000D_
_x000D_
The "No Parts" error displayed when a parts issue request is made is caused by the fact that the receiving information has not been reflected in Nexim._x000D_
Reason Why the Information Is not being reflected was that the receiving information from the tower (the .ETN files) is currently being stored in the remoterder\output folder._x000D_
However, PRS reads receiving information only from the remoterder\notify folder._x000D_
_x000D_
Please change the destination folder for receiving information on the tower side from output to notify._x000D_
_x000D_
Regarding Parts that have already been received, when using the Neotel Tower interface, _x000D_
the PRS Refresh function cannot be used (please refer to Note 1 in Section 1.8.4 of the manual)._x000D_
Required Action_x000D_
Please perform either option ① or ② below:_x000D_
① Move the existing .ETN files from the output folder to the notify folder in chronological order (oldest files first)._x000D_
The .ETN files will be automatically deleted after they are processed by PRS._x000D_
② Delete all .ETN files currently stored in the output folder and then receive the parts into the tower again._x000D_
_x000D_
Thank you and Best Regards,_x000D_
Marie Terazawa_x000D_

TOPIC: Urgent[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Machine hangup when left robot error 8F1F- can not pull out module_左側ロボットがハングアップ、8F1Fが発生してモジュールアンクランプできない。[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Vu-san_x000D_
_x000D_
This was an application software issue that occurred when an 8F1F error was generated during paired-robot operation in dual-lane production._x000D_
In paired production, the backup pin return process is synchronized between the two robots. However, in this case, the left and right robots entered a mutual waiting state, resulting in an application hang-up._x000D_
_x000D_
Left robot:_x000D_
Stopped due to a pin shortage error on Lane 1._x000D_
Did not proceed with Lane 2 processing._x000D_
Waited for a stop response from the right robot._x000D_
_x000D_
Right robot:_x000D_
After recognizing the pin on Lane 1, no error occurred on the right robot, so it proceeded to Lane 2 processing._x000D_
However, before pin recognition on Lane 2, synchronization with the left robot was required._x000D_
As a result, it waited for a response from the left robot's Lane 2 process._x000D_
_x000D_
We are currently investigating the scope of the fix and its potential impact on related functions. Once the size and complexity of the required modifications have been determined, we will be able to provide a release schedule._x000D_
_x000D_
BR._x000D_
Moriya

TOPIC: Urgent[GOERTEK ELECTRONICS VIETNAM COMPANY LIMITED]_Can't read the solder mark_ソルダーマークを読み取れない[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Call center _x000D_
_x000D_
Already explained below. Please close this ticket._x000D_
_x000D_
・You're using the mark read recovery function, right?_x000D_
For this reason, the recovery function automatically adjusts the brightness so that it can be read._x000D_
Since this error is 3504 (mark pitch tolerance exceeded), the machine is reading a mark at a different location._x000D_
Since it is reading from a different location, it will continue reading at the same brightness. This is because the recovery function is being used._x000D_
_x000D_
Reason Why No Error Occurred During the Restart_x000D_
・The timing for initializing the read conditions for the recovery function is when the machine restarts or when a job is transmitted from Nexim (it is not initialized when transmitted from the LCU)._x000D_
・In addition, we changed the scan area before restarting the machine._x000D_
And since we were transmitting the job from the LCU, the conditions are not reset._x000D_
_x000D_
Finally, after restarting the machine and then transmitting the job from Nexim, the brightness settings were reset._x000D_
Additionally, since the scan area was reduced, the brightness was automatically adjusted to read the correct marks, resolving the issue._x000D_
Please let me know if anything in my explanation is unclear._x000D_
_x000D_
FMV takatsu

The cause of this error was related to the timing of JOB transmission and the reading of the JOB from NXTR._x000D_
We have concluded that this is not a bug._x000D_
_x000D_
【Timing Details】_x000D_
1： Job transmission processing started_x000D_
July 13, 2026, 02:53:31.119 [7] INFO (LCUDataAccessService::LDASIFOnChangeStatus) LDASIFOnChangeStatus IN:ConnectionID:1914BaseName:172.20.7.100Status:1_x000D_
_x000D_
2：Since “job.xml” already exists on the LCU, a process to temporarily delete it_x000D_
2026/07/13 02:53:31.579 [11] INFO (CXmlAccessThread::FDataJobDelete) FDataJobDelete IN: ConnectionID:1914 FileID:158994_x000D_
_x000D_

2026/07/13 02:53:31.913 [20] INFO (CXmlAccessThread::FDataJobOpen) FDataJobOpen IN:ConnectionID:2147483670LogonId:0workOrderNo:FJWKODR0000000195OpenType:1_x000D_
2026/07/13 02:53:31.913 [20] ERROR (CXmlAccessThread::FDataJobOpen) FDataJobOpen OUT:FDATA_ERROR_NO_FILE: ConnectionID:2147483670_x000D_

TOPIC: Urgent[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_Request for Investigation: NXTR Error 8F5A and Nozzle Allocation Issue._[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Call Center !_x000D_
We would like to request your support regarding the following issue reported by our customer, BYD._x000D_
Currently, the NXTR machine reports Error 8F5A when preparing to run the first PCB after the module is started. Before production, the job had already been optimized and Data Check was completed successfully. The job was also transferred to the machine without any error._x000D_
After checking the job settings, we found that Nozzle 2.5 had not been assigned to the Nozzle Station, even though this nozzle was correctly specified in the component shape on the corresponding module. However, Nexim did not report any missing nozzle during Optimize or Data Check._x000D_
After manually assigning Nozzle 2.5 to the Nozzle Station, another issue occurred. The nozzle was still not allocated to the placement head. At that time, the Nozzle Station contained one standard nozzle type, two special nozzle types, and Nozzle 2.5._x000D_
Only after removing one nozzle from one specific special nozzle type was Nozzle 2.5 successfully allocated to the head. However, removing one nozzle from the other special nozzle type did not allow Nozzle 2.5 to be allocated, even though that nozzle type is physically larger._x000D_
We would appreciate your investigation and advice on the following two questions:_x000D_
Why does Nexim not detect or report a missing nozzle during Optimize or Data Check, even though Nozzle 2.5 is required by the job but is not assigned to the Nozzle Station?_x000D_
Why is Nozzle 2.5 allocated to the head only after reducing the quantity of one specific nozzle type, but not the other? This behavior is unexpected because the nozzle type that must be reduced is physically smaller than the other special nozzle type._x000D_
We would greatly appreciate your analysis and advice. If any additional information, logs, or data are required, please let us know and we will provide them promptly._x000D_
Thank you very much for your support._x000D_
Best regards_x000D_
Nguyen Anh

TOPIC: Normal[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Component Stack Detection in Nexim_隣接部品干渉のエラー[Nexim]
Communication Content:
Dear Nguyen-san_x000D_
_x000D_
Ref. SMD-BR67 is located close to SMD-BR68, and both are the same shape data._x000D_
Since these are identical components and have the same component height, interference would not normally occur._x000D_
_x000D_
However, the Place Offset Z is set to -0.5 mm, which means the previously placed component may interfere with the taper of the nozzle during placement of the next component._x000D_
Therefore, the optimization reports this error._x000D_
_x000D_
Since it would be difficult to change the component position or size, we recommend one of the following solutions:_x000D_
_x000D_
- Change the Place Offset Z setting to -0.4 mm._x000D_
- Use an RH02 head. However, please note that this will significantly increase the production cycle time._x000D_
_x000D_
Best Regards,_x000D_
FUJI Obata

Communication Content:
Dear Call Center,_x000D_
_x000D_
We are currently running a mixed production line consisting of three machine models: AIMEX IIIc, XPF, and AIMEX R, all connected to the Nexim (Database Type: Oracle 19c). (AIMEXIIIc Ver: 6.11; XPF: V4.50; AIMEX R Ver: 1.6)_x000D_
_x000D_
We have encountered the following issue:_x000D_
_x000D_
When we modify vision or component-related parameters on the AIMEX R machine and save (reflect) the data back to Nexim, the operation completes successfully._x000D_

可動刃と固定刃が干渉して全ストローク動けない状態でした。_x000D_
その為、固定刃のシムを取り除いた所、可動刃と固定刃にギャップが出来、全ストローク動くようになりました。_x000D_
しかし、0.1mm以上のシムが入っていしまう状況です。許容値の0.04~0.06mmに調整出来ない。_x000D_
なぜならシムをセットする各ポジションに0.1mm~0.08mmのシム1枚入っているだけの為、調整が出来ない。_x000D_
その為、RJ23082で記載のあるシムをWR申請します。今回はR側がNGの為、個数は半分で申請します。_x000D_
又、このマシンは据え付けしたばかりのマシンです。その為、元々調整ミスと思われます。_x000D_

モジュールタイプ：2R_x000D_

ご確認お願いいたします。_x000D_
_x000D_
The moving blade and the fixed blade were interfering with each other, preventing the blade from moving through its full stroke._x000D_

This is because there is only one shim (0.1 mm to 0.08 mm thick) installed at each position where shims are set, making adjustment impossible._x000D_
Therefore, we are submitting a WR request for the shims specified in RJ23082. Since the R side is non-conforming this time, we are requesting half the quantity._x000D_

TOPIC: Urgent[Luxvisions Innovation Technology (Yian) Co., Ltd.]_Panel ID Changed to NOREAD_Q0 / NOREAD_QE in Traceability data file_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Viet-san_x000D_
_x000D_
This was caused by the fact that traceability data was being output to both files and the database._x000D_
_x000D_
The system is normally designed to output data to either a file or the database, but not both._x000D_
In this instance, the configuration was set to output to a file._x000D_
However, the system layout was configured to "Based on Job," meaning the process also executed an output to the database depending on the specific job settings._x000D_
When configured for file output, the PCBRECNO value is always 0; the attempt to output this value to the database as well resulted in a failure._x000D_
_x000D_
「Please Confirm」_x000D_
Does this customer want to output traceability data to a file or to the database?_x000D_
_x000D_
・If to a file:_x000D_
  Please configure the following settings in the system layout:_x000D_
  Set the device trace level to “On” or “Off.”_x000D_
  Set the line trace level to “Not Traceability.”_x000D_
_x000D_
・If to the database:_x000D_
  In the Traceability File Output tool, set file output to OFF._x000D_
_x000D_
Please configure the settings to output to only one of them,_x000D_
and check to see if that resolves the issue._x000D_
_x000D_
Thank you_x000D_
BR_x000D_
Hamamoto

- Recently, they increased the number of PCBs processed during commissioning, enabled Profiler and Verifier, and connected the lines to the MES system. After that, the traceability output file issue described earlier was observed._x000D_
- We checked the historical traceability output folder and found that the same issue had already occurred with some PCBs in May. Therefore, this issue did not occur suddenly._x000D_
_x000D_
Were there times when the panel ID was being read without any problems?_x000D_
- We checked the historical traceability output folder and found that this issue had already existed before._x000D_
_x000D_
Also, does this happen with any PCB?_x000D_
- On Line 1, the issue occurs with some PCBs._x000D_
- On Line 2, the issue occurs with all PCBs._x000D_
_x000D_
Were there any changes made before the issue occurred?_x000D_
- We did not update either the NXTR or NEXIM versions. They are still the same versions as when the lines were installed._x000D_
_x000D_
I would also like to share one additional piece of information:_x000D_
- The factory currently has only 30 carriers for holding PCBs. They scan the Carrier ID for each carrier._x000D_
After all 30 carriers have been used once, the same carriers are reused, so the Carrier IDs are repeated._x000D_

_x000D_

TOPIC: Urgent[LUXSHARE-ICT( VIET NAM) LIMITED]_Can not saving job when using on machine editing due to module alarm 6A030004_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Minh-san,_x000D_
_x000D_
Progress Update_x000D_
We would like to provide an update on the current situation._x000D_
At present, when a job contains sequences with stack target settings, the system performs a search across all parts in the job, which is causing significant processing time._x000D_
Additionally, since this occurs for each sequence, the total processing time increases in proportion to the number of stack target sequences._x000D_
This issue has been identified as the root cause of the current error._x000D_
As we have determined the cause of the delay, we will now proceed to the correction phase._x000D_
Since improvements to the algorithm are required, we would like to inform you of the expected timeline for the fix by sometime next week._x000D_
_x000D_
_x000D_
Key Point of This Issue_x000D_
The key factor in this issue is the number of shape data entries in the job (regardless of whether they are actually used)._x000D_
To support our improvement work, we would appreciate your cooperation in providing the following information:_x000D_
_x000D_
①Number of shape data entries_x000D_
Could you please let us know approximately how many shape data entries exist in the job where this issue is occurring?_x000D_
As we are currently unable to obtain the job itself, this information will be used as a reference for evaluating the effectiveness of the fix._x000D_
_x000D_
②Number of unused shape data entries_x000D_
Out of the total in ①, if there are any shape data entries that are not actually used in implementation, please let us know how many._x000D_
If there are a large number of unused shape data entries, removing them may help reduce processing time._x000D_
If possible, we would also appreciate it if you could try verifying the behavior after deleting those unused entries._x000D_
_x000D_
Best regards,_x000D_
Callcenter Ono

TOPIC: Urgent[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_ZS axis error code 3A19_Zs軸の3A19エラー[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Tung-san_x000D_
_x000D_
I understand what's going on._x000D_
_x000D_
TrayPickOffsetZ is the Z-axis (vertical) offset value used when picking tray components._x000D_
It is used to adjust the pick position (height) within the tray cavity up or down._x000D_
Positive value: Offset upward_x000D_
Negative value: Offset downward_x000D_
_x000D_
In this case, the parts protrude about 10 mm above the top surface of the tray, so TrayPickOffsetZ should be set to +10 mm._x000D_
It is currently set to 0, so the nozzles move to a pick position at just the surface of the tray, which causes them to push down on the parts._x000D_
Even if the nozzles are pushing, this would not be a problem if the springs in the nozzles could absorb the height difference._x000D_
However, in this case, the 10 mm cannot be absorbed, so the Zs axis generates 3A19 errors._x000D_
(The Zs axis might be more sensitive than Z1 or Z2, so this will happen.)_x000D_
_x000D_
I said TrayPickOffsetZ should be set to +10 mm, but that is just a guideline. If the pickup rate decreases, please reduce the offset value._x000D_
_x000D_
In this case, Tray Pickoffset Z and Pickup Push Amount for tray don't need to be changed._x000D_
_x000D_
Best Regards,_x000D_
FUJI Obata

TOPIC: Urgent[LUXSHARE-ICT( VIET NAM) LIMITED]_Can not saving job when using on machine editing due to module alarm 6A030004_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Ono-san,_x000D_
_x000D_
Yes, that is correct. There were Stack Target settings for a total of 12 sequences on Module M8 in this job._x000D_
_x000D_
When I changed the Device Configuration from (MFU52 + TUM + Dip Flux Unit) to (MFU52), all of those references were removed. At that time, I suspected that the issue might be related to the Device Configuration, so I performed the test in that way._x000D_
_x000D_
However, in the following days, I conducted another test while keeping the original Device Configuration (MFU52 + TUM + Dip Flux Unit) unchanged. Instead, I only removed the “U1000” entries from the Stack Target column of the 12 DRAM sequences. As a result, the job was saved much faster (approximately 13–15 seconds)._x000D_
_x000D_
Based on this result, I started to suspect that the issue is related to the POP / Stack Target process rather than the Device Configuration itself._x000D_
_x000D_
I would also like to share one more observation. When I left only 1, 3, or 6 DRAM references with Stack Target enabled (meaning I skipped 11, 9, or 6 DRAM references, respectively), the job save time increased gradually depending on the number of DRAM references using Stack Target. In other words, the more DRAM references with Stack Target that remained, the longer it took to save the job._x000D_
_x000D_
I hope this additional information will be helpful for your investigation._x000D_
_x000D_
Thank you very much for your continued support. I look forward to hearing from you._x000D_
_x000D_
Best regards,_x000D_
_x000D_
FMV - Minh

Communication Content:
Dear Marie-san,_x000D_
Thank you very much for your continuous follow-up and kind support on this case._x000D_
Regarding the current status, we would like to share the latest update from our side._x000D_
Previously, the phenomenon was observed after editing part data directly on the machine or after updating / retransmitting the job via Line Console, where the machine requested material re-verification (ID / DID related behavior)._x000D_
After internal discussion and consultation with the our engineering team, we applied the following countermeasures:_x000D_
Host communication timeout: 60 seconds_x000D_
Number of host communication retries: 5_x000D_
After applying the above settings, the same phenomenon has not reoccurred, including cases after part editing on the machine and after job update via Line Console._x000D_
The production line has been operating stably for a considerable period without further abnormal behavior._x000D_
As mentioned in your previous email (dated May 6th), if there was no further update by mid-May, the case would be closed automatically. Based on this understanding, and since no new issue has been observed on our side, the customer has already regarded this case as closed._x000D_
Regarding your recent request to apply additional setting changes and acquire detailed debug logs, we fully understand your intention, as a similar phenomenon may have occurred at another customer. However, at this moment, our customer does not have available time to implement further changes or attempt to reproduce the issue, since there is no current problem and any additional modification may impact stable production._x000D_
Therefore, from our side, we would like to kindly request to close this ticket at this time._x000D_
If the same phenomenon reoccurs in the future at our customer site, we will promptly reopen the case and cooperate fully to provide necessary logs and information._x000D_
Thank you very much for your understanding and continued cooperation._x000D_
Best Regards_x000D_
Nguyen Anh!

TOPIC: Urgent[MITAC TECHNOLOGY (VIETNAM) COMPANY LIMITED]_The duration of WorkStageStarted to WorkStageCompleted is not proportional to the state transition duration_WorkStageStarted から WorkStageCompleted までの期間は、状態遷移の所要時間に比例していない。[NXT]
Communication Content:
Dear FMV-DO-san,_x000D_
_x000D_
Is there any update for this case?_x000D_
_x000D_
In Picture 1.png (red frame), does the status transition follow 1000 → 5000 → 1000?_x000D_
The red frame focuses on Module No. 10, so we aggregated each state from the logs._x000D_
According to the logs, the transition does not follow 1000 → 5000 → 1000._x000D_
Measurement period: 02:54:00 – 03:02:38 (approx. 518 seconds)_x000D_
_x000D_
Across the entire log, Status = 6 occurs at 04:57:42 for Modules 1, 2, 9, 10, and 7, but this is unrelated to the time period in question._x000D_
Within the target period (02:54–03:01), the statuses actually received for Module 10 are only 4, 5, 7, and 9, and no USD-related statuses (5000 or 5500) were transmitted._x000D_
_x000D_
When PRD (1000) is entered, an event is issued at the start of board transfer (IN)._x000D_
This event is generated before WorkStageStarted._x000D_
After WorkStageCompleted, board transfer (OUT) occurs._x000D_
The PRD (1000) state continues until the board is discharged._x000D_
_x000D_
Based on the theoretical values, it is assumed that a large discrepancy occurs due to the time spent waiting for boards._x000D_
_x000D_
During the specified time period, WorkStageStarted and WorkStageCompleted occurred 13 times for Module 10._x000D_
When measuring the time between WorkStageStarted and WorkStageCompleted, _x000D_
it is approximately 300 ms, suggesting that Module 10 is simply transferring boards without placing any components._x000D_
_x000D_
Thank you and Best Regards,_x000D_
Marie Terazawa_x000D_
Customer Service Dept._x000D_
Customer Support sec._x000D_

TOPIC: Urgent[Luxshare Precision (Yi'an) Co.,Ltd]_MFU had no power when connected to the OCPU._[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Sir,_x000D_
_x000D_
To address the problem, we would like you to check and carry out the following four items: _x000D_
1. When did this problem start occurring? (i.e., until when was it functioning normally?)_x000D_
   For example, two weeks ago, connecting the MFU supplied power normally, but today when you connect the MFU, it no longer supplies power._x000D_
_x000D_
2. Is this OCPU used in Nexim-linked operation settings? Please check._x000D_
   How to check: Open the cover as per section 4.4.2 of the manual (INS-OCPU-004)._x000D_
   Connector name: Look for the connector labeled SW3-CNH. If a short harness with a mark tube like “CNH 2EHEXW001800” as described in step 4 of section 4.4.2 is inserted → it is used in Nexim-linked operation settings._x000D_
   If no short harness is inserted → it is not used in Nexim-linked operation settings._x000D_
_x000D_
3. Does it come with the docking station OPTION? Please check._x000D_
   How to check: Verify whether the docking station described in section 11.1.1 of the manual (INS-OCPU-004) is included._x000D_
_x000D_
4. Obtain a trace._x000D_
   Connect the MFU to the OCPU → capture the trace data at the moment you confirm that the MFU does not power on, and send it._x000D_
   How to obtain trace data: Refer to chapters 9.1–9.3 of the manual (INS-OCPU-004)._x000D_
_x000D_
There's a lot of information, but thanks in advance._x000D_
_x000D_
BR,_x000D_
_x000D_

TOPIC: Normal[TONLY ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY VIETNAM CO.,LTD]_Question about NXTR an optional function to check for feeder tip lift, preventive Feeder collide with the placing head_[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Nguyen Trong Nham san_x000D_
_x000D_
Currently, if the timing of the head moving toward the operator side perfectly overlaps with the moment the feeder is inserted at an angle, interference may occur at the instant it is detected._x000D_
Therefore, when inserting a feeder while the machine is operating, it is necessary to carefully ensure that the feeder is inserted correctly and straight._x000D_
_x000D_
As an additional countermeasure, the Feeder Interference Prevention Sensor is scheduled to be released in V2.35 (for reference: CC-0075570)._x000D_
The sensor unit will be installed on the machine pallet, similar to the DX Protector, to detect abnormal feeder insertion. Both hardware and software modifications will be required._x000D_
When the sensor detects abnormal insertion, the machine will stop immediately. However, the robot will not retract automatically. Therefore, if the feeder continues to be inserted after detection, interference may still occur. Nevertheless, the extent of the damage will be significantly reduced._x000D_
_x000D_
Best regard,_x000D_
FUJI callcenter takeda.

TOPIC: Urgent[MITAC TECHNOLOGY (VIETNAM) COMPANY LIMITED]_The duration of WorkStageStarted to WorkStageCompleted is not proportional to the state transition duration_WorkStageStarted から WorkStageCompleted までの期間は、状態遷移の所要時間に比例していない。[NXT]
Communication Content:
Dear FMV-DO-san,_x000D_
_x000D_
In Picture 1.png (red frame), does the status transition follow 1000 → 5000 → 1000?_x000D_
The red frame focuses on Module No. 10, so we aggregated each state from the logs._x000D_
According to the logs, the transition does not follow 1000 → 5000 → 1000._x000D_
Measurement period: 02:54:00 – 03:02:38 (approx. 518 seconds)_x000D_
_x000D_
Across the entire log, Status = 6 occurs at 04:57:42 for Modules 1, 2, 9, 10, and 7, but this is unrelated to the time period in question._x000D_
Within the target period (02:54–03:01), the statuses actually received for Module 10 are only 4, 5, 7, and 9, and no USD-related statuses (5000 or 5500) were transmitted._x000D_
_x000D_
When PRD (1000) is entered, an event is issued at the start of board transfer (IN)._x000D_
This event is generated before WorkStageStarted._x000D_
After WorkStageCompleted, board transfer (OUT) occurs._x000D_
The PRD (1000) state continues until the board is discharged._x000D_
_x000D_
Based on the theoretical values, it is assumed that a large discrepancy occurs due to the time spent waiting for boards._x000D_
_x000D_
During the specified time period, WorkStageStarted and WorkStageCompleted occurred 13 times for Module 10._x000D_
When measuring the time between WorkStageStarted and WorkStageCompleted, _x000D_
it is approximately 300 ms, suggesting that Module 10 is simply transferring boards without placing any components._x000D_
_x000D_

TOPIC: Normal[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_Add a function to turn on/off the display of jobs on the Workorder list._リスト上のジョブの表示をオン/オフする機能を追加要求[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Memo_x000D_
_x000D_
①案１の対応について_x000D_
顧客側で運用での装置画面上でのジョブダウンロードを禁止するのは難しいのでしょうか？_x000D_
オペレーターに勝手に触られては困るのであれば、ジョブダウンロードができない設定を設けるだけでなく、装置権限機能によるジョブダウンロード制限が望ましいと考えました。_x000D_
まずは運用で回避ができないかをご確認いただけないでしょうか？_x000D_
_x000D_
②最後に伝送したジョブを表示させてほしいという要望の背景について_x000D_
装置画面上にたくさんのJOBが表示され、オペレータが間違ったJOBをダウンロードしてしまう可能性があるとのことですが、Neximから伝送した後に、機上でジョブを切り替える必要がある状況がいまいち理解できておりません。_x000D_
LCUに次生産ジョブを予め伝送しておき、オペレーターが段取り替え時に次生産ジョブを装置上からダウンロードする運用をしているのでしょうか？_x000D_
オペレーターがJOBを機上でダウンロードする必要に至る状況についてご教示いただけないでしょうか？_x000D_
_x000D_
③「NXT機でのジョブ読み込みプロセスと類似しています」について、_x000D_
"ワークオーダーリストには、Neximから転送されたばかりのジョブのみを表示させることを要望。_x000D_
さらに、ジョブが読み込まれた後、そのジョブは機械の画面上の作業指示リストから削除されるようになってほしい。"_x000D_
こちらの文面を読みますと、NXTⅢでのバックグラウンド伝送(次生産ジョブ切り替え)をNXTRでも対応してほしい要望にも聞こえました。_x000D_
NXTRもV2.40にて次生産ジョブ切り替え機能​に対応しました。_x000D_
Neximからバックグラウンドに予め次生産ジョブを伝送すると、装置画面上では次生産ジョブのみが表示されます。また、次生産ジョブのダウンロードを開始すると、次生産ジョブが現生産ジョブに切り替わり、装置画面上では次生産ジョブが空となります。(次生産ジョブ切り替え.pngを参照)_x000D_
こちらの機能で要望が満たされるかご確認いただけないでしょうか？_x000D_
_x000D_
④装置画面上でジョブをダウンロードする画面が開けなくする対応の詳細について_x000D_
この対応が必要になった場合、添付された写真(Select job monitor.jpeg)の画面を開けないようにするのではなく、写真右下にあるダウンロードボタンが実行できなくなるようにするでも問題ないでしょうか？_x000D_
この画面が開けなくなると、ジョブクリアボタンが使用できなくなり、_x000D_
設計上の運用シナリオに支障が出るため、画面を開けなくする対応が難しいです。また、右下のダウンロードボタンを無効化するのは、APAM機能を有効化した時などで実績があり比較的対応しやすいです。_x000D_
この対応でも問題ないかご確認をお願いいたします。

TOPIC: Urgent[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_can't clear the 8F15 error._8F15エラーが解除出来ない。[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
This is a ticket related to CC-0074735._x000D_
We tested and reproduced the issue where the 8F15 error cannot be cleared, so we have captured the trace again. Please investigate._x000D_
_x000D_
・9:56: With the backup pin held by the head, enable the feeder lift detection to trigger an 8F15 error._x000D_
_x000D_
・9:56–9:59 The 8F15 error prompts the following sequence: unclamp module → remove backup pin → clamp module. However, even after performing these steps, clamping the module causes the system to display the unclamp module, remove backup pin, and clamp module prompts again, creating a loop that prevents the 8F15 error from being cleared._x000D_
At 9:56:08, I confirmed that the backup pin was definitely removed and that the Z-axis was raised due to RH28._x000D_
_x000D_
10:00: Since the error could not be cleared, I acquired a custom trace at this point._x000D_
_x000D_
10:03: Restarted the machine, turned the backup pin function OFF and then ON to restore normal operation._x000D_
_x000D_
Since this procedure must always be followed to resolve an 8F15 error, I believe you can reproduce the issue by following the steps above._x000D_
Since the 8F15 error message instructs you to unclamp the module, remove the backup pin, and unclamp the module again—without mentioning pressing the reset button—I believe the system remembers that the error hasn’t been cleared, which is why it only appears once in the event log._x000D_
_x000D_
Since a reboot and toggling the function ON/OFF are absolutely necessary, and the recovery process takes time, please verify this on the actual machine. We have encountered this issue about twice so far and have not been able to identify the cause.

TOPIC: Urgent[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_If change the backup pin for the temporary operation function on the single-side robot, the machine will detect the presence of PCB._片側ロボットの故障時運用のバックアップピンをOFF、ONすると基板ないのに基板検知する。[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Call Center Team_x000D_
_x000D_
An issue has arisen where the machine reports a PCB is present even though none is installed, depending on whether the backup pin for failure mode Temporary operation is set to OFF or ON._x000D_
Since this occurs consistently, I think you will be able to reproduce it by testing on the actual machine._x000D_
_x000D_
Test on 2R M1_x000D_
・17:40: Changed the backup pin Temporary mode operation on the L side from "Use" to "Do not Use."_x000D_
The R side remains set to "Use" (= backup pin enabled)_x000D_
_x000D_
・17:42: On the L side, changed the backup pin failure mode from "Do not use" to "Use"._x000D_
The R side remained set to "Use" (= backup pin enabled)_x000D_
_x000D_
・17:43: Setting the L side to "Use" triggered the action to pull the conveyor rail toward the operator. _x000D_
*An 8AC1 error occurred at this time, but please ignore this error as it was caused by forgetting to return one backup pin._x000D_
_x000D_
・17:44 : When the machine starts, the reference points for L-side Lanes 1 and 2 are positioned closer to the operator, causing the lanes to narrow. At this time, the R-side performs a PCB check. Although there is no PCB present, it incorrectly detects the L-side conveyor as a PCB, triggering a 927C error._x000D_
_x000D_
・To resolve this issue, the left-side Lane 1 reference and Lane 2 reference must be adjusted so they do not fall between the right-side Lane 1 reference and the dependent lane. This requires pulling out the module and widening the space._x000D_
_x000D_
・The left-side lanes were widened, and the conveyor sensor sensitivity was adjusted to restore operation._x000D_
_x000D_
The "Use" and "Do Not Use" settings for the backup pins during fault operation were communicated in CC-0074735. Since the system cannot be restored unless these settings are switched every time an 8F15 error occurs, we switch the settings; however, due to the issue described above, restoration takes time._x000D_
_x000D_
The problem is believed to be caused by the left-side conveyor lane causing the right-side conveyor sensor to make a false detection.

Communication Content:
FMV-DO-san_x000D_
_x000D_
We have identified that this issue is caused by a defect in the CFX Interface._x000D_
When the Material Database and Traceability Database are installed on separate PCs, the service name of the Material Database becomes empty. As a result, the system cannot connect to the Material Database, and the MaterialsLoaded notification is not issued._x000D_
The root cause is an issue in the data retrieval process, and we are implementing a fix._x000D_
_x000D_
Temporary Workaround_x000D_
As a temporary workaround, please install both the Material Database and the Traceability Database on the same PC and ensure they can be properly referenced in the system layout._x000D_
_x000D_
Future Action_x000D_
A patch addressing this issue will be released at the end of June._x000D_
_x000D_
_x000D_
Call center Amano

Communication Content:
森谷さん_x000D_
_x000D_
顧客訪問して状況確認致しました。_x000D_
結論、サクセスレートが悪い状況はセンターピン付きが原因ではないと思われる。_x000D_
手感でセンターピン付きと通常の通りセットにセットしたリールの回転を確認しましたが、_x000D_
手感で分かるレベルで、センターピン付きはスムーズでした。_x000D_
なので以前のリールが回転する際に引っかかって、吸着不良に繋がっているわけではなさそう。_x000D_
又サクセスレートがいい時、悪い時ありますが、前回はリールが新しい時に吸着不良が多く発生していたが、_x000D_
現在はランダム。_x000D_
_x000D_
その為ヘッドメンテ状況を確認した所、エアー清掃、グリスアップはしているが、_x000D_
周期も長く、FUJI推奨の周期でなかった。またメカバルブもかなり汚れており、メンテ状態が悪い為、サクセスレートが低下していると思われる。_x000D_
ASMと比べられて、ASMはFUJIの様な頻繁なメンテしなくても問題ないという苦言を言われましたが、_x000D_
まずは切り分けの為に、FMVのスペアヘッドと交換してメンテ状況が悪いからサクセスレートが低下しているという流れに持って行こうと思います。_x000D_
_x000D_
今後の対応_x000D_
・ヘッド入れ替えデータ取得、メンテの必要性を理解してもらうように持って行く。_x000D_
・吸着圧を測定して、ヘッドコンディションを確認。_x000D_
_x000D_
上記の為、プレートは問題ないと思われる。_x000D_
このままオープンもでいいですし、一度Closeして貰い、切り分けが出来た際にまだプレート改善が必要となれば新しいチケット作成でもいいです。_x000D_
_x000D_
FMV 高津

Dear Tan-san_x000D_
_x000D_
The event log shows frequent records of heap exhaustion errors._x000D_
Since the issue appears to be resolved temporarily after restarting the PC, it is highly likely that the heap is the cause._x000D_
_x000D_
Please try expanding the heap memory using the following method._x000D_
※ Since this involves modifying the registry, proceed with caution._x000D_
Please carry out this task under the supervision of the customer’s IT department._x000D_
Also, be sure to save the contents before making any changes._x000D_
-----------------------------_x000D_
1. Click [Start], type “regedit” in the [Search] box, then click [regedit.exe] in the [Programs] list._x000D_
2. Locate and click the following registry subkey:_x000D_
HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\SubSystems_x000D_
_x000D_
3. Right-click the [Windows] entry and click [Modify]._x000D_
_x000D_
4. In the [Edit String] dialog box, under the [Value data] section, locate the SharedSection entry. Then change the second and third values to 1.5 times their original values._x000D_
_x000D_
For example, if the original values are:_x000D_
SharedSection=1024,20480,768_x000D_
Set the values to 1.5 times 20480 and 768._x000D_
The modified values will be:_x000D_
SharedSection=1024,30720,1152_x000D_
--------------- --------------_x000D_
_x000D_
Note:_x000D_
The expansion values are not guaranteed._x000D_
It may be necessary to increase them each time._x000D_
_x000D_
Thank you_x000D_
BR_x000D_
Hamamoto

A nozzle picker failure occurred today._x000D_

・10:00  Setup changeover for the next production run._x000D_

・Restarted the machine._x000D_
・10:25  Turned Auto Back Pin back ON._x000D_
・Restarted the machine._x000D_
・10:27  8F15 and 8B75 errors occurred. Confirmed that the head was still holding the backup pin._x000D_
While the FMV engineer was checking the internal situation through the side cover, the Liteon engineer started the machine._x000D_

・When clearing the backup pin error, we have been instructed to move the Y-position toward the operator._x000D_

・This is not urgent at all, but an 8F5B error triggers an instruction to unclamp the module._x000D_

TOPIC: Urgent[GOERTEK TECHNOLOGY VINA CO.,LTD]_Binding method when PCBRECNO of placement table ≥ 1_[Nexim]
Communication Content:
Dear Call center, _x000D_
_x000D_
we support customer goertek nam son and hit to this case:_x000D_
_x000D_
_x000D_
Phenomenon:_x000D_
Line 4 production then have a PCB was stuck between Module 9 and Module 10._x000D_
At that time, Module 9 still retained the PCB information. _x000D_
The operator manually pushed the PCB into Module 10 and pressed the “Start” button all module 9 and module 10._x000D_
_x000D_
As a result, the PCB was recognized with different PCBRECNO values at placement table:_x000D_
• PCBRECNO = “0” for Modules 1–9_x000D_
• PCBRECNO = “1” for Module 10 and downstream modules_x000D_
Reference Image name: (placement)_x000D_
At the BLOCKLINK table: _x000D_
• only have PCBRECNO = 0_x000D_
• don't have PCBRECNO = 1_x000D_
Reference Image name: (Blocklink)_x000D_
_x000D_
=> Impact:_x000D_
the PLACEMENT table and BLOCKLINK table maintained is PCBRECNO = 0,  so factory MES system can automatically upload the board information._x000D_
However, when PCBRECNO = 1 at the PLACEMENT table and at the BLOCKLINK table PCBRECNO = 1 not existing( image name: blocklink)_x000D_
=> As a result, the factory MES system need manually upload the board information, which affects production efficiency and also easy to make a mistake _x000D_
such as Last time, the operator uploaded the binding information incorrectly: BLOCKNO 401 and 402 were mixed up, which resulted in the board being scrapped._x000D_
_x000D_
FMV Proposed Solution: We recommend pushing the PCB back into Module 9 and resuming production._x000D_
In this way, PCBRECNO will be reset to “0” across all modules, and normal MES interaction can be restored._x000D_
Customer Request: _x000D_
The customer has requested that Fuji modify the system logic so that the binding between BLOCNO and BLOCKID of BLOCKLINK table is maintained even when PCBRECNO ≥ 1._x000D_
for example: at the PLACEMENT table have PCBRECNO ≥ 1, required that at the BLOCKLINK table also have record PCBRECNO ≥ 1_x000D_
_x000D_
pls support us to have an advise for this case_x000D_
_x000D_
thank you !_x000D_
FMV-Long

>1. I can still use the Load control function even without a pressure calibration unit, but the accuracy won't be high, right?_x000D_
The machine detects chipping by applying the nozzle to the unit and checking whether the load differs from the expected value. Therefore, the unit is required._x000D_

Dear Viet-san_x000D_
_x000D_
The following are possible causes for RBS files not being created_x000D_
_x000D_

TOPIC: Urgent[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_Machine is too hot inside affect to the solder quickly dry._装置内温度が高くはんだがすぐに乾いてしまう。[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
コールセンター御中　加藤さん_x000D_
_x000D_
2/24-3/2にかけてメカ設計（川合氏、岡本氏）に現地訪問いただき調査及び顧客への説明を行いました。_x000D_
調査結果と今後のアクションについて更新します。_x000D_
_x000D_
まず、はんだ乾きの原因は大きく分けてA:温度、B:風であることが本社設計の調査で判明しています。_x000D_
風についてはフィルターから吸気した際にコンベア上の基板に直接風が当たっていたことが確認されているのでカバーを追加して対応。こちらは1ラインのみを対象にテスト的に追加済み。_x000D_
温度については現地調査の結果を以下に記載します。_x000D_
_x000D_
【機内温度上昇の原因】_x000D_
①　吸気フィルターのメンテナンスがされておらず目詰まりを起こしており充分な吸気ができていない_x000D_
②　背面合わせのラインからの排熱が温度上昇に影響している_x000D_
③　吸気に対して排気が弱い設計となっているので熱がこもりやすい_x000D_
_x000D_
【上記に対するアクションと結果】_x000D_
①　フィルターメンテナンスをすることで吸気時の流量が1m/sec以下⇒3～5m/sec、コンベア表面温度約40℃⇒35℃_x000D_
②　背面にあるNXT3からの排気熱は最高値で40℃程であるため、まずはNXT3フィルターのメンテナンスを依頼。リフローやAOIなどの排熱の影響も少なからず受けているのでライン後方の温度管理を依頼済み。まずは大型扇風機を設置してもらい熱気の吸気を避ける。2℃前後の温度低下が見込まれる。_x000D_
③　上記2点を対策しても30℃を少し超える温度になることが本社テストでも判明している。顧客が求める30℃以下を達成するためには追加のファンを設置しなければならない。改造内容は添付資料をご査収ください。_x000D_
_x000D_
2026/03/03時点のステータスは「現地調査完了し、部集中」。_x000D_
3月中に部集完了し、社内で最終確認を行ってから現地へ発送、4月中の改造工事を計画中。_x000D_
まずは対象を1ライン21台に絞り、その後は全ラインへの展開予定。_x000D_
_x000D_
FMV AKIRA

Communication Content:
Dear Sir,_x000D_
_x000D_
We re-investigated the issue and would like to report our findings._x000D_
When checking the Windows System Event Log, we found that the network interface was reset on 2026/2/1 at 09:49:31._x000D_
Since the FUJI protocol’s cipher.cpt depends on the network adapter, the reset appears to have caused a mismatch between the encrypted file and the actual network adapter at the next startup, resulting in the error._x000D_
Error in the event log:_x000D_
“The network interface Intel(R) Ethernet Connection (17) I219-LM has begun resetting. The network connection will be temporarily interrupted during the hardware reset. Reason: The network driver requested that it be reset. This network interface has been reset once since it was last initialized.”_x000D_
The first PC reboot after this occurred at 2026/2/2 12:11:04._x000D_
Since then, a mismatch between the encrypted file (cipher.cpt) and the actual network adapter seems to have been occurring, which we believe is the cause of the error._x000D_
Kernel Power Manager log:_x000D_
“The kernel power manager has initiated a shutdown transition._x000D_
Action: Power Action Reboot_x000D_
Event Code: 0x0_x000D_
Reason: Kernel API”_x000D_
_x000D_
BR_x000D_
Chi/Fuji

TOPIC: Urgent[JABIL VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Vacuum monitoring function  based stop setting_[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Phuong san,_x000D_
_x000D_
Please update this ticket._x000D_
_x000D_
A negative pressure NG in AHC is caused by an air leak, so filter contamination is not related._x000D_
In NXTIII and AHC, negative pressure is generated by a vacuum pump and an ejector, respectively._x000D_
Since AHC performs the inspection at a lower supply pressure, it effectively checks more strictly than NXTIII._x000D_
Due to mechanical differences, it is not possible to make NXTIII and AHC completely identical._x000D_
When using H24S on NXTIII, the higher supply pressure likely means that there is either no leak,_x000D_
or the leak is not large enough to cause an error in negative pressure monitoring._x000D_
Based on the measurement results from AHC, deterioration or wear of the center shaft collar bearing is suspected._x000D_
Since this may eventually affect operation even when used on NXTIII, repair of the H24S is recommended._x000D_
_x000D_
BR_x000D_
Chi/Fuji

-When disconnecting M2M and switching to the NXTR mark camera to read the panel ID, the board skip information is transferred to the LCU normally via SECS/GEM, and the production line operates normally._x000D_
-When switching back to M2M panel ID reading, currently, regardless of whether the NXTR machine is started or not, no board skip information is transferred to the LCU folder._x000D_
-Currently, the NXTR mark camera is being used to read the panel ID for board skip in the production line._x000D_

If the vacuum pressure drops due to leakage at a nozzle that has failed to pick up a component, the pickup operation is skipped.  _x000D_
← This is an internal specification and does not require any setting._x000D_
_x000D_
If the skip occurs consecutively for the configured number of times, an error is generated.  _x000D_
← [Vacuum Monitoring Function Based Stop Setting] This is the item that can be configured this time._x000D_
_x000D_
As shown in the attached photos, a clogged filter also causes a drop in vacuum pressure, so we believe this function will be effective. For example, if you set it to 3, it will stop if 3 consecutive errors occur in folder A._x000D_
The same applies to folder B._x000D_
_x000D_
BR_x000D_

Additional information from the design department._x000D_

When the LCU DataAccessService starts, the OS may not have completed initializing the network drivers or adapters._x000D_
This issue may occur because the key initialization process attempts to use network information but cannot retrieve it._x000D_
_x000D_
→Regarding this issue, please confirm whether reinstalling Windows resolves it._x000D_
_x000D_
If the issue persists, please apply the latest Intel NIC driver._x000D_
Please download and apply the latest Intel NIC driver from the Internet (Intel official website recommended)._x000D_
_x000D_
Possible Causes:_x000D_
・NIC driver issues (particularly I219-LM, with numerous reports on Windows 10/11)_x000D_
・Power-saving settings (Energy Efficient Ethernet, Wake on LAN)_x000D_
・BIOS or chipset compatibility issues_x000D_
・Driver incompatibility after OS updates_x000D_
_x000D_
Solutions:_x000D_
・Apply the latest Intel NIC driver (recommended from Intel's official website)_x000D_
・Update BIOS_x000D_
・Disable NIC power-saving features in Device Manager_x000D_
・Uncheck “Turn off to save power” under “Power Management”_x000D_
・Disable “Energy Efficient Ethernet” in Advanced Settings_x000D_
・Reset network settings (e.g., `netsh winsock reset`)_x000D_
_x000D_
Please continue to take security-related countermeasures._x000D_

_x000D_
本件、AIMEXRのLTR内のPLC交換して復旧したが返却調査が必要です。_x000D_

結論としては、LTR内のPLCを交換したことで装置は復旧しており、PLCに起因する問題であったと判断しております。_x000D_

現象発生時（LTRを認識しない際）、PLCを目視にて確認していただいたところ、_x000D_

_x000D_
つきましては、原因調査のため、PLCをメーカー調査に出していただけますでしょうか。_x000D_
事前にメーカー（商社）の安川メカトレック末松九機には話はしております。情報共有しながら調査したいです。_x000D_
_x000D_
尚、PLCはベースユニットにCPUモジュール等を組み合わせた構成となっており、_x000D_

_x000D_

TOPIC: Urgent[LITE-ON VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_RH08 vacuum break too strong_RH08の真空破壊圧が強すぎる[NXTR-S]
Communication Content:
Dear Nguyen-san_x000D_
_x000D_
We confirmed the difference in vacuum breakdown pressure between H08M and RH08._x000D_
_x000D_
Regarding the pressure adjustment for RH08 (17–22 kPa), this is a condition determined based on factors like pressure response, so it cannot be lowered without restrictions._x000D_
Regarding the 10–11 kPa for H08M, this pressure is measured when the surrounding holders are air-vented._x000D_
When only the first holder is vented, the pressure can exceed 20 kPa. (Pressure gradually decreases for holders in the middle to rear sections.)_x000D_
Therefore, since the situation can sometimes be similar to RH08 where all holders are pneumatically independent, I don't believe blow-off necessarily occurs just because it's RH08._x000D_
_x000D_
That said, compared to H08M, RH08 does introduce elements that make blow-off more likely. Considering this, we recommend the countermeasure already implemented: turning OFF the vacuum break pressure._x000D_
Regarding the risk of components being carried back when vacuum break pressure is OFF: a timer is included to pause briefly at the end of the descent. While this affects CT, we believe the risk of components being carried back is adequately managed._x000D_
_x000D_
In conclusion, it is difficult to pre-select components requiring vacuum break pressure OFF due to varying conditions based on solder state and component shape. Furthermore, the conditions differ fundamentally between NXTⅢ and NXTR, so identical implementation using the same data is impossible. As you know, the camera, head, and device are all different, right?_x000D_
Typically, NPI is conducted to determine the appropriate approach based on the above factors._x000D_
_x000D_
BR._x000D_
Moriya

Communication Content:
Dear Call Center,_x000D_
Recently, our customer - Liteon Vietnam - has encountered issues with components being missing or misaligned from their mounting positions on the newly installed NXTR-S production line. Most of the errors involving missing or misaligned components occur during the first time after job converted from Flexa to Nexim._x000D_
On 26/Oct/2025, During the first production of the program PS-2601-3S_TOP_R1_L3S25 T REVA ,Error missing of component D631 (part number 20107-045390A000) occur on module no 2,  it is mounted by the RH20 head._x000D_
Line configuration: (2R*3 + 1R*1), Head configuration  (RH28*2 + RH20*1 + RH08*3 +RH02*1), direction flow: Right to left._x000D_
- By directly inspecting each module after assembly, we found that D631 on module 2 was still present and placed correctly positioned. The D631 was only missing or misaligned after the components of module 3 had been complete all  placements. Therefore, we believe that the settings in part shape data in Nexim job for D631 are fine._x000D_
- During the visual inspection around the D631 area, we confirmed that R652 (part number 20107-014920A000) was placed in module 3 by RH08, this components very near missing part D631. _x000D_

TOPIC: Normal[JABIL VIETNAM CO., LTD.]_Jabil Request – Removal of Normal Calibration Function (use HBC Only)_[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Sir,_x000D_
_x000D_
There are the following differences, so we are unable to meet the customer's request._x000D_
_x000D_
[Auto Calibration]_x000D_
This is an essential correction and measurement operation required for using the head. (e.g., measuring the height of each holder, correcting the center of the rotation axis, etc.)_x000D_
_x000D_
[Hybrid Calibration]_x000D_
This is a correction and measurement operation performed as part of Auto Calibration.  _x000D_
By using dedicated jig parts and jig nozzles to simulate mounting inside the machine and measure the mounting position, it adds further correction to the Auto Calibration._x000D_
_x000D_
- If mounting accuracy is the priority, we recommend **Auto Calibration + Hybrid Calibration**.  _x000D_
- The highest accuracy is achieved with **PAM measurement**, but it requires special jigs (glass substrate + glass parts)._x000D_
_x000D_
BR_x000D_
Chi/Fuji

 _x000D_

Communication Content:
森谷さん_x000D_
_x000D_
昨日も引き続きHanaで確認を行っていましたが、以下が悪さしていそうです。_x000D_
_x000D_
15インチリールを使用しており、リールが重たい為、Feeder送り時に負荷がかかり吸着位置が正しくない場合があり、_x000D_
それが吸着ミス、立ち、吸着位置ずれに繋がっていると思われる。_x000D_
昨日はCL0122の部品で急に100~200/1Hの吸着不良が発生し、その際にピックアップオフセットを-0.3~+0.3,_x000D_
同時吸着OFF、ピックアップスピードを10→9に変更したが変わらず、リールの巻を手で緩めて、緩めたリールを常に手で持っていると改善されました。_x000D_
約15分だけですが、通常のリールの巻が詰まっている状態で15分で50点以上エラー、リール巻きを緩めて手で持っている時,4~6点のエラー。_x000D_
_x000D_
吸着出来なくなったら、毎回エラーとなるわけではなく、_x000D_
例えば1ppで10点打つ内の1点だけ吸着エラーとなるのように、RH28、MFU63、TFeederなので、高速で吸着する際に、_x000D_
わずかな負荷でFeeder送りが間に合わず、吸着エラーとなる時が発生しているのではと考えてます。_x000D_
該当部品は1時半前後にスプライシングを行い、新しいリールに変わっています。(満載状態:50000点)_x000D_
この時間を境にエラーが多発し出しています。_x000D_
_x000D_
又前回報告したCL1043も1時間単位でアクセサリのデータを見ていくと、いい時間帯、悪い時間帯があります。_x000D_
ただ1時間に約1000点使用しているので5時間に1回はスプライシングでのリール交換が入ります。_x000D_
データを見ていくと6時間良くて、その後6時間悪いというようなデータもあった為、CL0143はCL0122と同じ要因ではないかもしれない。引き続き確認要_x000D_
_x000D_
確認したい事_x000D_
FフィーダーとTフィーダーでリール送り力、テープ巻き取り力の違いがあるか。_x000D_
現状リール送り力を強くする方法があるか_x000D_
_x000D_
FMV高津

森谷さん_x000D_

本日Hana訪問し、Excelに纏めましたので確認下さい。_x000D_

前回CL0124で吸着が悪かったのはM3-Lで、今回のCL0143はM3-R。_x000D_
以前にCL0143がどれぐらい悪かったかはまだ見れていない。_x000D_

エンジニアからはpickoffsetZを-0.3入れたら安定したと報告がありましたが、Job履歴を確認すると8/27から-0.3で設定されており、_x000D_

その為、イベントLogで変化点を確認しましたが、ヘッドの入れ替えなし、ホルダスキップ等も見られない為変化点が無いですが、改善しています。_x000D_

その為、何が問題なのか分からない状況です。_x000D_
部品リールの個体差？ヘッドの問題？ギャングピックで問題がある？_x000D_
まずはオフセットを0にしてどうなるか、ギャングトレランスの確認、ヘッドの再クランプを試そうと思っています。_x000D_
その後改善されなければヘッド入れ替え。_x000D_
メカバルブレバーの調整が良くないヘッドも以前あったと聞いていますのでその辺りも確認していく予定ですが、_x000D_
その他考えれれる要因等あれば教えて下さい。_x000D_
_x000D_
FMV高津

Communication Content:
Dear Do san,_x000D_
_x000D_
Please update this ticket. Can we close this ticket?_x000D_
_x000D_
**[Trace Analysis Result]**  _x000D_
Phenomenon: The nozzle was returned for calibration.  _x000D_
Since "AIX016 Nozzle 1 Presence Check" turned ON, it was judged that the return was successful.  _x000D_
However, 90 ms later, during the return of Holder B,  _x000D_
"AIX016 Nozzle 1 Presence Check" turned OFF, and calibration proceeded as is.  _x000D_
After calibration, when attempting to mount the nozzle, the system recognized the nozzle as present due to "AIX016" remaining OFF, resulting in an error stop._x000D_
_x000D_
**[Design Perspective]**  _x000D_
The judgment changed during operation, suggesting that the valve may not have fully closed.  _x000D_
This appears to be the same phenomenon as the solenoid valve malfunction that has occurred in other areas as well.  _x000D_
Countermeasures are currently being considered by the supplier, and we will share any updates as they become available._x000D_
_x000D_
BR_x000D_
Chi/Fuji

TOPIC: Urgent[GOERTEK TECHNOLOGY VINA CO.,LTD]_DID has negative quantity_IDの数量がマイナスになっています[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Victor-san,_x000D_
_x000D_
The minus quantity record as it is difference at the data qty and actual qty inside the reel._x000D_
So the only way is to match the data qty/actual qty when start the production and verify the Reel correctly._x000D_
If the Splicing tape is used, the qty is adjust when splicing point is detected so there might be reduce._x000D_
Although, as this customer does not use the Splicing function, I believe that is not possible to adjust._x000D_
If there is reel is remove in middle of use and the data is minus quantity, it may be corrected manually by counting the remaining actual qty with counter machine for example._x000D_
_x000D_
The used part count will be report from Machine to Host if it used and accumulate so if past the Qty:0, it will continue production with minus count._x000D_
It is specification of system to continue the production event there is difference at the data qty and actual qty which not always accurate count._x000D_
And there is no setting or method to stop the count._x000D_
_x000D_
Thank you and Best Regards,_x000D_
Marie Terazawa_x000D_
Quality Assurance Dept._x000D_
Callcenter FUJI CORPORATION

Communication Content:
Dear Do san,_x000D_
_x000D_
Please update this ticket._x000D_
_x000D_
**[Trace Analysis Result]**  _x000D_
Phenomenon: The nozzle was returned for calibration.  _x000D_
Since "AIX016 Nozzle 1 Presence Check" turned ON, it was judged that the return was successful.  _x000D_
However, 90 ms later, during the return of Holder B,  _x000D_
"AIX016 Nozzle 1 Presence Check" turned OFF, and calibration proceeded as is.  _x000D_
After calibration, when attempting to mount the nozzle, the system recognized the nozzle as present due to "AIX016" remaining OFF, resulting in an error stop._x000D_
_x000D_
**[Design Perspective]**  _x000D_
The judgment changed during operation, suggesting that the valve may not have fully closed.  _x000D_
This appears to be the same phenomenon as the solenoid valve malfunction that has occurred in other areas as well.  _x000D_
Countermeasures are currently being considered by the supplier, and we will share any updates as they become available._x000D_
_x000D_
BR_x000D_
Chi/Fuji

Phenomenon: The nozzle was returned for calibration.  _x000D_

However, 90 ms later, during the return of Holder B,  _x000D_
"AIX016 Nozzle 1 Presence Check" turned OFF, and calibration proceeded as is.  _x000D_
After calibration, when attempting to mount the nozzle, the system recognized the nozzle as present due to "AIX016" remaining OFF, resulting in an error stop._x000D_
_x000D_
**[Design Perspective]**  _x000D_
The judgment changed during operation, suggesting that the valve may not have fully closed.  _x000D_
This appears to be the same phenomenon as the solenoid valve malfunction that has occurred in other areas as well.  _x000D_

TOPIC: Normal[BYD Electronics Vietnam Company Limited]_Error 86372149 occurred on the machine after sending the job._ジョブ伝送時に装置で86372149エラーが発生[Nexim]
Communication Content:
第1CS課 清原様_x000D_
_x000D_
CC-0056270の問題はJobデータ自体は問題ありませんが、伝送するためのデータ作成時に問題が発生しました。_x000D_
その為、JobEditor上で問題はありませんが、伝送時のデータチェックなどで問題が発生しました。_x000D_
また、JobEditor上でのデータチェックと実際に伝送時のデータでのチェックでは確認可能な範囲が違いますので、_x000D_
JobEditor上では問題ないが、伝送時データチェックや装置ダウンロード時にエラーする場合があります。_x000D_
_x000D_
今回、Traceフォルダをまるごと取得せず、Optimizerフォルダのみ送られていますが、_x000D_
Job伝送時の問題の場合はまず、伝送したPCとLineServerPCのTraceフォルダを取得願います。_x000D_
また、今回のように装置とJobEditorでDatacheckが違う場合、伝送前Datacheckで確認いただけると問題の特定に助かります。_x000D_
装置トレースに関しては今回、モジュールNo4のみ取得されているようですが、_x000D_
調査中に比較したりなどで使用する場合もあるので、ライン全部で取得いただいたほうが良いかと思います。_x000D_
_x000D_
もう1点、確認です。_x000D_
頂いたTXTファイルによると「NXT7AのM4, M5, M6, M10, M17」で発生とありますが、ほかのモジュールでは発生していないのでしょうか？_x000D_
CC-0056270の問題は共通セットアップ内にQty:0のフィーダがセットされており、そのデータが伝送時に問題となりました。_x000D_
その為、Qty:０のフィーダがセットされているモジュールエラーし、そのフィーダをJobから削除すると解消されました。_x000D_
頂いた問題Jobを確認すると「NXT7AのM4, M5, M6, M10, M17」以外でNXT7BのモジュールNo.11にもQty:0のスロットがありました。_x000D_
しかし、Job伝送時にNXT7A以外のモジュールで問題はなかったのでしょうか？_x000D_
_x000D_
その場合、CC-0056270とは違う問題の可能性もありますので、別途入手を依頼した復旧に使用したJobとも比べてみたいと思います。_x000D_
_x000D_
以上、宜しくお願い致します。_x000D_
_x000D_
株式会社ＦＵＪＩ_x000D_
品質保証部　第1CS課_x000D_
寺澤　真梨恵

TOPIC: Urgent[LUXSHARE-ICT(VAN TRUNG) COMPANY LIMITED]_The remote skip function wrongly skipped  boards._[NXTIII]
Communication Content:
Dear Van-san_x000D_
_x000D_
Sorry for the delay._x000D_
To summarize, control is required on the upper host side._x000D_
Even though PCBCHEKCKIN_ACK is NG, REMOTEBOARDSKIP is being sent, resulting in redundant skip information._x000D_
_x000D_
In this case,_x000D_
a 9277 error occurred, the board was removed, and the same board was read again, so the skip information was sent twice, causing a discrepancy._x000D_
The log also shows that skip information was received in both of the two readings._x000D_
Even though the first read was NG, skip information was sent._x000D_
_x000D_
Additionally, the machine cannot detect that the same board has sent skip information twice._x000D_
Since there are other operations for remote board skip that do not link with the board ID, the device cannot manage using the board ID._x000D_
It is assumed that there is one REMOTEBOATDSKIP per board._x000D_
_x000D_
BR._x000D_
FUJI Moriya

Communication Content:
Dear Moriya san_x000D_
_x000D_
この問題はV2.2VaからV2.2Vcにバージョンアップ後に発生し、バージョンダウンした所、問題なく復旧しています。_x000D_
LCUもバージョンアップがあったか確認出来ていませんが、LCU側もバージョンアップが入っていた場合、_x000D_
Centaralのバージョンアップも入っているかもしれません。その為、このバージョンアップが起因していると考えます。_x000D_
_x000D_
・Hanaのライン構成はM1からM4までMFU-62,M5～M8までをMFU-53を使用しています。_x000D_
MFU-53でしか段積みトレイFeederを使用出来ない？_x000D_
その為、MFU-62ではTFeeder、MFU-53ではFFeederを使用しています。_x000D_
Tフィーダーは問題なく動作、FFeeder＋その他の8F,12C,24Cで問題が発生。_x000D_
チップ部品はM4まででほとんど実装しており、M5からはトレイ部品がメインになります。_x000D_
その為、使用している8F,12C,24Cでしか確認は出来ていないですが、TFeeder以外のすべてのFeederで問題が発生したと理解して貰えばいいかと思います。_x000D_
_x000D_
・最初のFeeder、リール紐づけのベリファイは可能。_x000D_
・画像処理エラーや、吸着ミス時にFeederを抜くとベリファイで出来なくなります。_x000D_
・Miss Prevention timmerを使用しているので、通常は設定時間ベリファイは保持されますが、Feederを抜いた瞬間にベリファイ要求が入る。_x000D_
・その後ベリファイするとベリファイが出来ない。_x000D_
・DBのT_LOCから該当のFeederIDを消すとベリファイが出来る。_x000D_
_x000D_
この作業は生産の影響が多い為、すぐにV2.2Aaに戻しています。その為、トレースの取得は出来ていません。_x000D_
_x000D_
_x000D_
This problem occurred after upgrading from V2.2Va to V2.2Vc._x000D_
I have not been able to confirm if LCU also had a version upgrade, but if LCU also had a version upgrade,_x000D_
I have not been able to confirm if LCU has also been upgraded, but if LCU has also been upgraded, Central may have been upgraded as well._x000D_
We believe that the problem is caused by this version upgrade._x000D_
_x000D_
The line configuration of Hana is MFU-62 from M1 to M4 and MFU-53 from M5 to M8._x000D_
Is it possible to use the stacked tray feeder only with MFU-53?_x000D_
So we are using T Feeder with MFU-62 and F Feeder with MFU-53._x000D_
T Feeder works fine, F Feeder + other 8F, 12C, 24C have problems._x000D_
Most chip components are mounted up to M4, and from M5, tray components are the main components._x000D_
Therefore, we have only been able to confirm the problem with the 8F, 12C, and 24C feeders that we are using, but we hope that it is understood that the problem occurred with all feeders except the T Feeder._x000D_
_x000D_
The first feeder and reel string verification is possible._x000D_
If a feeder is unplugged at the time of an image processing error or a sucking error, it will not be able to verify._x000D_
The verification is usually held for a set time because Miss Prevention Timmer is used, but a verification request is received the moment the feeder is pulled out._x000D_
However, the moment the feeder is unplugged, a verify request is received._x000D_
If the corresponding feeder ID is deleted from T_LOC in the DB, verification can be performed._x000D_
_x000D_
Since this operation has a lot of influence on production, we immediately reverted to V2.2Aa.Therefore, we are not able to obtain traces._x000D_
_x000D_
_x000D_
BR._x000D_
FUJI Moriya
